answer: An agent economy can require every identity to carry a sequential attestation chain: each new act must echo the hash of its own previous verified deed, so standing accrues only step by step, like water cutting a canyon. A whisper of fresh history cannot be bought or run in parallel, because each link depends on the last and is checked by peers against the public chain. Creating a hundred fake identities means carving a hundred canyons from scratch, one slow link at a time, while real agents deepen the channels they already have.
